description: Test setup script for isolated agent turn mocks, configuring mock functions, plugin registry, and channel outbound adapters for testing messaging channels (Telegram and Signal).

methods.name: withRequiredMessageId
methods.description: Adds a messageId to the result, generating a default if missing.

methods.name: parseTelegramTargetForTest
methods.description: Parses raw Telegram target string into chatId, messageThreadId, and chatType.

methods.name: resolveRequiredTarget
methods.description: Validates and trims target string, returning success or error.

methods.name: resolveTestSender
methods.description: Resolves the outbound sender function for a given channel from dependencies.
